LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 12.1.1 PROPER ARTICULATION OF SIGNS AND VOCABULARY: SPEAKING OR SIGNING FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: CLEAN ENVIRONMENT Suggested vocabulary to be signed: compound, bin, bush, tree, 
Topic 12.1: Observing and articulating signs 12.1.1 Proper articulation of signs and Vocabulary: Speaking or Signing Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and articulating signs 12.1.1 Proper articulation of signs and Vocabulary: Speaking or Signing Fluency, part of CLEAN ENVIRONMENT Suggested vocabulary to be signed: compound, bin, bush, tree,  in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should you speak as we sign at the right speed? 2. How can you make others feel what you are saying?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and articulating signs 12.1.1 Proper articulation of signs and Vocabulary: Speaking or Signing Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: signing clearly as learners make short speeches accurately, at the right speed and with expression.

● Creativity and imagination: exploration as learners create signed speeches on topical issues.

Values:
Unity: cooperation is developed as learners, in groups, make three-minute signed speech on environment.

Link to other subjects:

Learner is able to link the skill of signing fluency to their learning in Kiswahili, Science and Technology ,Social Studies, Mathematics, Integrated

Science, Agriculture and Nutrition, Religious Education and Creative Arts
